name: Ziwei Palace
description: Ziwei Palace, part of the imperial palace in Luoyang City during the Sui and Tang Dynasties, got its name because "there is Ziwei Palace in the sky, which is the residence of God. The king established the palace and the elephant made it." Its scale is six times that of the Forbidden City and 1 million square meters more than the Daming Palace. It is magnificent, luxurious and magnificent, and has become a model for palace architecture in later generations. In 1988, some of its sites were listed as the third batch of national key cultural relics protection units, which have important historical, scientific and artistic values.
